{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment history shows negative bias (e.g., -0.25 or 0.00) and model overestimates prices.",
    "Reduce forecast magnitude by 5-10% if recent true outcomes show mean reversion toward lower levels after a spike.",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to recent low prices when sentiment is neutral or slightly negative (0.00), to avoid underestimating rebounds.",
    "Apply lag correction: if true outcome is significantly lower than forecast 3-5 days prior, adjust current forecast downward by 3-5%.",
    "Avoid over-optimism after sharp price spikes: if model forecasts a spike followed by a steep drop, reduce peak forecast by 10-15%.",
    "When sentiment history includes a 0.50 (positive sentiment), slightly increase forecast to account for potential bullish momentum, but cap at 10% above prior peak.",
    "If true outcome consistently underperforms model (e.g., 3-5% below), apply a downward bias correction of 2-5% for next forecast horizon.",
    "For 30-day forecasts, reduce forecast volatility if sentiment is flat (all 0.00) to avoid overfitting to recent noise."
  ]
}
